gloss: The part of the gland on the inner side of the facial nerve, around the vein and artery behind the jaw.
role: The superficial and deep lobes are a surgical division defined by the plane of the facial nerve; by weight about two-thirds of the gland lies superficial to it, and most tumours arise there.
matters: A total parotidectomy removes both the outer and the inner parts of the gland while the nerve is kept; in benign disease it is kept for tumours that reach the inner part.
